caption: The drawing features a single long dress prominently displayed in the center, rendered in grayscale pencil on a light beige background. The dress has a square neckline, puffed short sleeves, a fitted bodice gathered under the bust, and a long skirt that falls to the floor with a hemline accentuated by an additional seam or band near the bottom. The skirt appears to be gently pleated or gathered, as indicated by vertical shading lines. In the upper right corner of the page, there is a smaller sketch depicting the back view of the same dress, showing the arrangement of the bodice, sleeves, and skirt from behind. The background is plain, and the artist’s name, "Mary Humes," is written in the lower right corner of the page.
title: Dress
